$comment: SYNTHETIC. The shape an operator reaches for to grant 'the issue tools' in
one line: an allow rule whose prefix ends MID-TOKEN, after the underscore.
This fixture is the counterexample. `matches()` compares a `*` rule as a
`issue_view` as intended — and `issue_create` too, which is a write. The
table shows what the rule actually reaches.
Claude Code's own matcher does the opposite with a mid-token prefix: a
`Bash(git push origin agentns/:*)` rule stops at a SPACE and so matches
nothing anyone would type. Same spelling, two readings — see NOT_ESTABLISHED
